the slot-die technique is a promising coating technique for the fabrication of YBCO coated conductor.

the viscosity of solution is the most significant parameter for the coating conditions of single buffer layer.

the coating condition of SCO single buffer layer via the slot-die coating method can be controlled by the viscosity of solution and the moving speed of substrate, and the release rates of solution can be adjusted by the viscosity and the moving speed.
